name: playlist-search-extension
description: Build + typecheck + test tooling for the YouTube Playlist Search Chrome extension. Esbuild bundles src/content.js + src/lib/*.js into src/content.bundle.js (the file Chrome injects); tsc --checkJs gates drift; node:test runs the fixture-driven intent + InnerTube suites; tests/test-sheet-render.mjs pins the save-sheet UI contract in a real engine.
